answer: Every claim climbs the canyon of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the relic re-runs the work instead of trusting the label. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The design leans on reciprocity-weighted attestation, forfeited on duplicate submission, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the echo is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
